criterion: K >= ceil(LP*); a feasible dual of mass > r-1 proves K = r
rounding: masses rounded DOWN to denominator 10000000, which preserves feasibility
DO_NOT_READ_THE_MASS_AS_A_MEASUREMENT: exact_total_mass is rounded DOWN so that feasibility is preserved. It is therefore a safe LOWER bound on the optimum and systematically understates it, here by about 1e-6. It must not be read back as the value of tau*: grading tightness on it reported this cell as having room when it has none. Use float_lp_optimum for how much room is left, and the exact mass only for the proof that K = r.
